title: Disappointed
text: Disappointed. I just finished putting this item together. I would not recommend this item right away. My hope is that it is sturdy enough to last for more then a year. It was difficult to put together because it is held together 90 percent by cam locks and multiple of them just fell out repeatedly after they were tightened in place which was odd because they are supposed to lock onto the cam screw when tightened but to no avail, many would not tighten properly and as you move the unit around they would just come out. Also, there are 2 cracks in the wood base near the bottom of the unit and I imagine the company was aware of these cracks when they shipped it to me because there is wood glue already on the cracks as if it will somehow keep the cracks from compromising the entire structure? The unit is a bit smaller than I had imagined but thats my fault for not paying closer attention to the size description. However, imagine my surprise when I finally get it all together, hoping that I can get a good year or two out of it and just deal with any issues that come up and then the CHAIRS ARE A DIFFERENT COLOR WOOD! They dont even match, so now, I am going to get to sand all the wood surfaces and stain them the same color which should take me longer than the unit will last!! Not happy and I do NOT recommend!!
